REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - MAY 1, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Community Development Department counter, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development counter during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.

3.

4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for comments related to items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person. Public comments on agenda items will be taken at the time the item is before the Commission.
5.
Approval of the Wednesday, April 3, 2024, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes
MINUTES
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2024-3, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 13049 CARAVEL STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-005-008).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 18: PRESENTATION PACKET
POWERPOINT PRESENTATION
6B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO PERMIT A HIGH SCHOOL STADIUM UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT FOR THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17700 DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO REMODEL AN EXISTING HIGH SCHOOL STADIUM UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT, INCLUDING IMPROVEMENTS TO THE GRANDSTAND BLEACHERS, FIELD, TRACK, AND OTHER HARDSCAPE, LIGHTING, AND LANDSCAPING UPGRADES AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17700 DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE PROPOSAL ALSO INCLUDES AN AMENDMENT TO THE EXISTING CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115).*
*A Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared and previously adopted/certified by the Cerritos City Council on February 27, 2003, which reviewed the Valley Christian High School Stadium as part of the Campus Master Plan of Development, in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). In addition, pursuant to Sections 15301 and 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 18: PRESENTATION PACKET
POWERPOINT PRESENTATION
7.
Communications
7A.
Reports from the Department of Community Development
7B.
Reports from Cerritos Planning Commissioners
During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Brown Act, there will be no discussion or action taken on any of the matters that may be presented during this agenda item.
8.
Adjournment

  CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

  Regular Planning Commission Meeting
  May 1, 2024
  City Council Chambers
  18125 Bloomfield Ave, Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Gene Burd
  Commissioner Bavin Gandhi
  Commissioner Gloria Perlas Pulido
  Vice Chair Carla Gilhuys

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Travis Van Ligten
  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila
  Current Planning Manager Sandy Cisneros
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Metrè Anthony
  Associate Civil Engineer Amandeep Mann

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  Commissioner Gandhi led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present, except Chair Jhaveri,
  who was noted absent.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  As no one came forward to provide public comment, Vice Chair Gilhuys declared the
  Public Comments and Suggestions portion of the meeting closed.

5.  Approval of the Wednesday, April 3, 2024, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: Commissioner Pulido moved to approve the Planning Commission regular
  meeting minutes of April 3, 2024, as presented. Vice Chair Gilhuys seconded the
  motion, which carried 3-0-2, with Chair Jhaveri noted absent and Commissioner
  Gandhi abstaining.

6.  Public Hearings

  6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN
  2024-3, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO
  CONSTRUCT A FIRST-FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN
   EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 13049 CARAVEL STREET, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-005-008).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Associate Planner Metrè Anthony presented a details of the proposed residential
  project. Questions about the landscaping, patio location, and adjacent property
  were raised.

  Vice Chair Gilhuys opened public comments. Seeing none, Vice Chair Gilhuys
  closed public comments.

  MOTION: Commissioner Gandhi moved to waive full reading of and adopt
  Resolution No. PC 2024-4: A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING
  COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2024-3, A PROPOSAL BY THE
  RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-FLOOR
  ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 13049 CARAVEL STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703.
  THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-
  5000) (APN 7028-005-008).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Commissioner Burd seconded the motion, which carried 4-0-1, with Chair
  Jhaveri noted absent.

  6B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY
  PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO PERMIT A HIGH
  SCHOOL STADIUM UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF
  DEVELOPMENT FOR THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES LOCATED AT 10818
  ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17700 DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE
  (OS) (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF
  PRECISE PLAN 2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY
  OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO REMODEL AN EXISTING
  HIGH SCHOOL STADIUM UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN
  OF DEVELOPMENT, INCLUDING IMPROVEMENTS TO THE GRANDSTAND
  BLEACHERS, FIELD, TRACK, AND OTHER HARDSCAPE, LIGHTING, AND
  LANDSCAPING UPGRADES AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17700
  DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE PROPOSAL ALSO
  INCLUDES AN AMENDMENT TO THE EXISTING CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF
  DEVELOPMENT. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS)
  (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115).*

City of Cerritos  May 1, 2024
Planning Commission Minutes  Page 2
   *A Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared and previously
  adopted/certified by the Cerritos City Council on February 27, 2003, which
  reviewed the Valley Christian High School Stadium as part of the Campus
  Master Plan of Development, in accordance with the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). In addition, pursuant to Sections 15301
  and 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines,
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh presented details of the proposed stadium
  remodel project. Commissioners asked about the previous and future phases
  of the subject property’s Master Plan of Development. Parking, pedestrian
  safety, and the amendment to the Campus Master Plan of Development
  were also discussed.

  Vice Chair Gilhuys opened public comments. Superintendent of Valley
  Christian Schools Troy Stahl discussed the subject property’s track and field
  surface, pedestrian safety, stadium capacity, and parking.

  MOTION: Commissioner Gandhi moved to waive full reading of and adopt
  Resolutions No. PC 2024-5 and 2024-6: A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS
  PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT 2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY PROPERTY OWNER
  VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO PERMIT A HIGH SCHOOL STADIUM
  UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT FOR
  THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND
  17700 DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT
  PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-
  017-036 AND 7034-018-115) and A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS
  PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN
  2003-1(E)(2024) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY
  CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO REMODEL AN EXISTING HIGH SCHOOL
  STADIUM UNDER PHASE IV OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF
  DEVELOPMENT, INCLUDING IMPROVEMENTS TO THE GRANDSTAND
  BLEACHERS, FIELD, TRACK, AND OTHER HARDSCAPE, LIGHTING, AND
  LANDSCAPING UPGRADES AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17700
  DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE PROPOSAL ALSO
  INCLUDES AN AMENDMENT TO THE EXISTING CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF
  DEVELOPMENT. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS)
  (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115).*

  *A Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared and previously
  adopted/certified by the Cerritos City Council on February 27, 2003, which
  reviewed the Valley Christian High School Stadium as part of the Campus
  Master Plan of Development, in accordance with the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). In addition, pursuant to Sections 15301
  and 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines,
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Commissioner Burd seconded the motion, which carried 4-0-1, with Chair
  Jhaveri noted absent.
